summary.en: The one object of a stream film: the thread of light that is the product's attention, drawn in three additive passes with a white-hot head while it travels; it branches (hooks, beams, strands) but never breaks. Also the engine every stream scene draws with (the template's film on one canvas).
summary.zh: stream 片里唯一的物体：代表产品注意力的那根光线，三层叠加发光，走动时有白热的线头；可以分叉（挂钩、光束、细丝）但从不断开。也是每个 stream 场景用来画的引擎（模板整片搬到一张画布上）。

fits: Every scene of a stream film; a line of light that ties loose things together.
notFor: A line that carries text; a line in a second colour; a light ground.

intent.en: Keep one thread on screen through the whole film: whatever arrives, the thread takes it, sends it or brings it back.
intent.zh: 让一根线贯穿整部片：不管来了什么，都是这根线接住、派出或带回。

content.en: Nothing to read: the thread's form (running, spine, hooked, taut).
content.zh: 没有字：只有线的形态（走动、主干、挂钩、绷紧）。

fits.zh: stream 片的每个场景；把散乱东西串起来的一道光。

notFor.zh: 要承载文字的线；第二种颜色的线；浅色底。

pairs.note: blocks hang off it by hooks

en: Draw it additively (lighter) over the night only: on a light ground the three passes turn into a grey smear.
It never breaks: a block leaves by folding back into it, a star by a beam that stays.
zh: 只在夜空上以叠加方式画：浅色底上三层发光会变成一道灰糊。
线从不断开：块是折回线里离开的，星是沿一条留下的光束离开的。

source.path: assets/templates/stream/film.js (thread, glow, star, renderSpine, render*); plan.js; sched.js; timing.rules.js; lang.js

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
